Subject (in full) Modern Dramatic Art Society - application for
registration refused

Made by/ and Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

On the morning of August 30, Zang Sao Pah
(章少白), applicant of the Modern Dramatic
Art Society, Lane 506, 24 Taku Road, was called
to the headquarters in accordance with the
instructions of the D.C. (Special Branch). He was
informed that his application for registration of
the society was being refused, and warned by
D.C. (Special Branch) that any meetings held will
result in a raid.

Logan
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

DATE 30 / 8 / 40

事由（全称）现代剧艺社 - 注册申请被拒

由 D.S.I. Logan 制作并转呈

8月30日上午，根据特别处副巡官（D.C.）的指示，现代剧艺社申请人章少白（Zang Sao Pah），住址为大沽路506弄24号，被传唤至总部。他被告知该社团的注册申请正在被拒绝，并受到特别处副巡官（D.C.）的警告，称任何举行的会议都将导致突击搜查。

Logan
副督察长 (D. S. I.)

特别处副巡官 (D.C.)。

Date August 29, 40

Subject Modern Dramatic Art Society - application for
registration. 現代劇藝社

Made by and Forwarded by L.S.I. Logan

Submitted herewith is an application,
together with translation, received from the Modern
Dramatic Art Society for registration. The
application makes mention of the following persons
as members of the committee :-

CHIUNG FEE (龔飛), clerk attached to
the Abattoir of the Public Health
Department of the S.M.C., 10 Sawgin
Road.

KING SZE SHUN (金賜勳), assistant of the
Yuan Li (源利) Tea Hong, 77 North
Chekiang Road.

KAN LOC (干路), accountant of the
Foh Lai Teh (福来德) Electric Supply
Company, 159 Hoopen Road.

Enquiries reveal that two of the committee members
know nothing of their appointment. One of them is
Mr. Chiung Fee who claimed to have no knowledge
of the existence of the society while the other is
Mr. King Sze Shun, who stated that he had only
agreed to become an ordinary member of the society
when it is inaugurated. Both emphasized that they
would not be held responsible for the organization.
It appears that Mr. Chiung Fee is a former fellow
student of certain of the members of the Society
and that they elected him to the committee in his
absence chiefly because he is an employee of the
S.M.C.

This society is promoted by one Zang Sao
Fah (常少白), principal of the Modern Stage and
Motion Picture Players' Institute (現代影劇演員專校)
which is located on the premises of the Tung Hwa

由 L.S.I. Logan 制作并转呈

现随文附上收到之现代剧艺社注册申请书及译文。申请书中提及下列人员为委员会成员：-

龔飛 (CHIUNG FEE)，职员，隶属于工部局公共卫生处屠宰场，地址萨吉恩路10号。

金賜勳 (KING SZE SHUN)，助理，源利 (Yuan Li) 茶行，地址浙江北路77号。

干路 (KAN LOC)，会计师，福来德 (Foh Lai Teh) 电力供应公司，地址霍宾路159号。

经查询发现，两名委员会成员对其任命一事毫不知情。其中一位是龔飛先生，他声称对该社团的存在一无所知；另一位是金賜勳先生，他表示仅同意在社团成立时成为普通成员。两人均强调他们不对该组织承担责任。看来龔飛先生是该社团某些成员的前同学，他们主要因为他是工部局雇员而在其缺席的情况下选举他进入委员会。

该社团由常少白 (Zang Sao Fah) 发起，他是现代影剧演员专校 (Modern Stage and Motion Picture Players' Institute) 的校长，该校位于东华

(左侧手写批注：已注册... 呼叫... 上述指示。归档 18。)
(底部手写批注：29/8 S.I. 29/8 29/8)

Primary School ( 東華小學 ), 24 Yoong Ching Fang
(Lane 506) Taku Road. It is at present in the
course of organization and has a communication
address in the school in question. According to
the promoter, the society consists of thirty members,
all being students and ex-students of the Modern
Stage and Motion Picture Players' Institute. Each
is to pay a membership fee of $1.00 per mensem.
The object is to provide the members with the
opportunity for practice after the formation of
the society.

There is nothing in Special Branch records
concerning the promoter. The society has no club
facilities.

In view of the irresponsible manner in
which the Society has been organized, it is suggested
that it be refused registration.

W Logan
D. S. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)
